regime_context: The TSX detector shows a broad, commodity-led leadership structure with Base Metals & Copper narrowly ahead of Oil & Gas Producers, both eligible and recent (durability_bar ~0.5-0.6, low absorption 0.3, one_narrative=false). The absolute-trend gate has historically helped on this market (gate_helps=true), but my own track record's direction accuracy is poor (0.347) despite a hit_rate of 0.66, so I will default to low conviction.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Oil & Gas Producers (XEG.TO) closes the 0.11 score margin to Base Metals & Copper (XBM.TO) for two consecutive weeks; a confirmed handoff would retire this watch, while a widening margin to >0.5 score would retire it in the other direction.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Base Metals & Copper is the detector's leader (rank 1, score 1.655) and is eligible via the absolute-trend gate, which is the only validated leg in this market. Current breadth (0.556) and a sub-1.5 crowding_z (0.9, not crowded) suggest leadership is not yet reflexive/frothy. A mean-revert hurst_tag is a caution against expecting smooth continuation, not a reason to avoid.
evidence: gate_helps=true (validated risk control on this market)
theses.dissent: A mean-revert hurst_tag and only ~22% lead over the oil challenger (margin 0.11) means leadership could flip quickly; copper/base metals are the most geopolitically sensitive group in the state, and macro_narrative has geopolitics as the only dominant theme with 100% unscheduled news share.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas Producers is a close challenger (rank 2, score 1.545) with the strongest eligible breadth in the state (0.571) and an eligible trend gate. The 0.11 margin to the leader is thin enough that oil is a legitimate second leg to the same commodity-leadership regime, not a fade candidate.
theses.dissent: The marginal momentum read is only an attention lens with rank-IC ~0 and my own dir_accuracy is 0.347; oil is highly exposed to the same geopolitics headline flow that could whipsaw either way.

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Technology is crowded (crowding_z 1.16, crowded=true) while its score (-0.21) is negative and it sits mid-rank (rank 8). Crowding is a size-down caution only, never a fade, so the honest expression is 'avoid adding here' rather than underweight: the theme has no attention flow and is reflexively full.
theses.dissent: Avoid-on-crowding can underperform if the crowded theme keeps grinding on momentum (reflexivity); the detector explicitly warns fading the leader is the failure mode, though Technology is not the leader here.

falsifier.text: XIT.TO outperforms the TSX benchmark by 8% before 2026-10-22

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
